description:
Run a group therapy practice from 8 Excel workbooks: intake, diary, client fees, payer claims, clinician pay, referrals and cash. One payment of 29 dollars, no subscription, no macros.

You own a small group practice, pay for practice software every month (often per clinician) and cannot see which service makes money. Type your numbers once and every dashboard, alert and tool reads from them.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
✓ Find the service that loses money after clinician pay, room time and materials, and test a fix before you change a fee
✓ See cash trouble 13 weeks ahead and take the safest owner draw
✓ Rank the waitlist so you know who to offer a place first
✓ Chase the clients who owe most first, and track every payer claim to payment
✓ Check each contractor statement against their invoice before you pay
✓ Never miss a late note or a renewal

WHAT IS INSIDE: 8 WORKBOOKS FOR ONE PRACTICE
1 Intake, Screening and Waitlist
2 Scheduling, Caseload and Rooms
3 Client Fees, Accounts and Packages
4 Third-party Payer Billing and Claims
5 Clinician Pay and Productivity
6 Clinical Admin and Renewals
7 Referrals, Marketing and Groups
8 Practice Profit, Cash Flow and Growth
Each workbook has 20 tables, 18 tools, 12 forms, 12 documents, 12 checklists, 34 ready message texts, 30 dashboard numbers, 22 charts and 6 gauges. In all: 144 tools, 160 tables, 96 forms and 272 message texts on {pages} ready pages. Each part comes as a blank workbook plus a copy filled with sample data.

WHO IT IS FOR
Owners, coordinators and clinicians of a group practice with employed, contract (self-employed) and associate clinicians. A solo therapist can use the intake, diary, fees, claims, admin and cash parts.
NOT FOR: a client portal, online booking, video sessions or claim filing. These are workbooks, not a web service. They track note status only, never note content.

HOW IT WORKS
1 Open the workbook for the job.
2 Replace the sample rows with your own.
3 Read the dashboard and use the tools.
Instructions are on the first sheet. Formula cells are locked against accidental edits (no password).

FILE FORMAT
Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. Tested in Google Sheets: everything calculates. No macros, no subscription. Dates follow your computer's regional format; change the currency symbol in one cell.

GUARANTEE
If a file does not work as described, we fix it, replace it or refund you within 14 days.

More answers are in the FAQ below.

faq.q: Do I need special software? Does it work in Google Sheets?
faq.a: No. The files are standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. We tested them in Google Sheets and everything calculates. There are no macros and no subscription.

faq.q: I am a solo therapist. Is it for me?
faq.a: Yes, in part. It is built for a group practice with an owner, clinicians, an associate and a coordinator. A solo practice can use the intake, diary, client fees, payer claims, clinical admin, referrals and profit and cash workbooks, and leave the clinician pay tools empty.

faq.q: Can I use my own currency and date format?
faq.a: Yes. Amounts are plain numbers and the currency symbol can be changed in one cell. Dates follow the regional format of your computer.

faq.q: Can I replace the sample data with my own?
faq.a: Yes. Every part comes as a blank workbook plus a copy filled with sample data, so you can explore first and start clean. Input cells are coloured, formula cells are locked against accidental edits (no password) and instructions are on the first sheet.
